f.title: Apply the AKBPM pharmacovigilance regulation to all MAHs of products marketed in Albania
f.statement: The regulation applies to all marketing authorisation holders, healthcare professionals and patients who report suspected adverse reactions to human medicinal products placed on the market in Albania.

rows.quote: Kjo rregullore zbatohet pér té gjithé mbajtésit e autorizimit pér tregtim, profesionistét e kujdesit shéndetésor dhe pacientét té cilét raportojné efektet e padéshiruara té dyshuara té barnave pér pérdorim njerézor gé vendosen né treg né Shqipéri.

rows.quote_en: This regulation applies to all marketing authorisation holders, healthcare professionals and patients who report suspected adverse reactions of medicinal products for human use placed on the market in Albania.

f.title: Report every suspected adverse reaction through the QPPV
f.statement: The MAH, through its qualified person for pharmacovigilance, must report every suspected adverse reaction to human medicinal products.

f.title: Operate a pharmacovigilance system to evaluate information and take risk minimisation measures
f.statement: The MAH must have a pharmacovigilance system through which it scientifically evaluates all information, considers options for risk minimisation or prevention and takes all necessary measures where justified.

rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder must compulsorily have within it a pharmacovigilance system, through which it scientifically evaluates all information, considers the options for minimising or preventing the risk, and takes all necessary measures if it considers it reasonable.

f.title: Classify ADRs as serious using the six seriousness criteria
f.statement: An adverse reaction is serious when it caused death, endangered life, caused or prolonged hospitalisation, caused permanent or severe disability or incapacity, caused congenital anomalies or birth defects, or caused other medically important conditions; all others are non-serious.

rows.quote: Njé efekt i padéshiruar konsiderohet serioz kur: a) ka shkaktuar vdekjen e personit b) ka rrezikuar jetén e pacientit c) ka shkaktuar shtrim né spital té pacientit ose zgjatjen e periudhés sé shtrimit né spital; ¢) ka shkaktuar invaliditet té pérhershém, té réndé ose paaftésim d) ka shkaktuar anomali té trashéguara apo defekte né lindje; dh) ka shkaktuar gjéndje té tjera té rêndésishme nga piképamja mjekésore.

rows.quote_en: An adverse reaction is considered serious when: a) it caused the death of the person b) it endangered the life of the patient c) it caused hospitalisation of the patient or prolongation of hospitalisation; ç) it caused permanent, severe disability or incapacity d) it caused hereditary anomalies or birth defects; dh) it caused other medically important conditions.

f.title: Include medication errors, off-label use, misuse and abuse; report on suspicion of causality
f.statement: Adverse reactions also include effects resulting from medication errors and use outside the primary indication, including misuse or abuse. A suspected causal relationship between the product and the effect is sufficient reason to report.

f.title: Treat an ADR report as valid with an identifiable reporter, patient, suspect product and reaction
f.statement: A report is valid when it contains at least an identified reporter, a patient identified by initials and/or age and/or sex, the suspect product name (trade name and/or INN) and the adverse reaction.

f.title: Submit PSURs with benefit-risk data, scientific evaluation and sales/exposure data
f.statement: The MAH submits to the Agency periodic safety update reports containing: summaries of benefit and risk data including results of all studies and their potential impact on the authorisation; a scientific evaluation of the risk-benefit balance based on all available data including clinical trials in unauthorised indications and populations; and all sales volume data and any prescription volume data held, with an estimate of the exposed population.

f.title: Submit PSURs electronically every 6 months, then yearly, then 3-yearly, or immediately on request
f.statement: PSURs are submitted electronically: at least every 6 months after authorisation until placing on the market; at least every 6 months during the first two years after first marketing; once a year for the following 2 years; then once every three years. If requested by the Agency, PSURs are submitted immediately.

rows.deadline: At least every 6 months, then yearly, then every 3 years; immediately on request
rows.quote: Raportet periodike té pérditésuara té sigurisé sé barit dorézohen prané Agjencisé né ményré elektronike, né pérputhje me afatet si vijon: a) nése njé bar nuk éshté vendosur ende né treg, té paktén edo 6 muaj pas léshimit té autorizimit dhe deri né vendosjen e tij né treg; b) nése njé bar éshté vendosur né treg, té paktén çdo 6 muaj né dy vitet e para pasuese té vendosjes pér heré té paré né treg; c) njé heré né vit pér 2 vitet e tjera pasuese; dhe, ¢) mé pas njé heré né tre vjet.

rows.quote_en: Periodic safety update reports of the medicinal product are submitted to the Agency electronically, in accordance with the following time limits: a) if a medicinal product has not yet been placed on the market, at least every 6 months after issue of the authorisation and until its placing on the market; b) if a medicinal product has been placed on the market, at least every 6 months in the first two years following first placing on the market; c) once a year for the following 2 years; and, ç) thereafter once every three years.

f.title: Submit risk minimisation measure materials to the Agency for information
f.statement: The MAH must submit RMM materials to the Agency for information.
f.clause: Neni 11(3) Plani i Menaxhimit të Riskut

rows.quote: Mbajtési i autorizimit pér tregtim duhet tê dorézojé né Agjenci (me qéllim informimin) materialet e Masave pér Minimizimin e Riskut MMR (Risk Minimization Measures).
rows.location: Neni 11(3) Plani i Menaxhimit të Riskut

rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder must submit to the Agency (for information purposes) the materials of the Risk Minimisation Measures (RMM).

f.title: Keep the RMP available throughout the product life cycle and notify the Agency of changes
f.statement: The MAH must have the RMP available at all times throughout the product's life cycle and must notify the Agency of changes to it.

rows.quote: Mbajtési i autorizimit per tregtim duhet té disponojé né edo kohé Planin e Menaxhimit té Riskut ( RMP) gjatë gjithé ciklit té jetés sé barit. Né rast té ndryshimeve né Planin e Menaxhimit té Riskut duhet té njoftohet Agjencia.
rows.review_note: Albania (non-EU; partial approximation to Directive 2010/84/EU). Text is OCR with character errors (é for ë, ç for ç); quotes copied as captured. Bilingual check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en; Albanian "duhet" = must (Mandatory), "mund" = may (Permitted), "detyrimisht/është i detyruar" = obliged (Mandatory). Review: OK. rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder must have the Risk Management Plan (RMP) available at all times throughout the life cycle of the medicinal product. In case of changes to the Risk Management Plan the Agency must be notified.

f.title: Submit DHPC with a communication plan and distribute only after Agency agreement; no advertising
f.statement: The DHPC is submitted by the MAH together with the communication plan and is addressed to healthcare professionals after the Agency agrees. The DHPC must not contain any form of advertising.
f.clause: Neni 12(2)-(3) Komunikim i drejtpërdrejtë me profesionistët e shëndetit

rows.quote: DHPC sé bashku me planin e komunikimit dorézohet nga mbajtési i autorizimit té tregtimit dhe pas shprehjes sé dakordésisé nga Agjencia, iu drejtohet profesionistéve té kujdesit té shéndetésor. 3. DHPC nuk duhet té keté né pérmbajtjen e saj asnjé formé té reklamimit té barit.
rows.location: Neni 12(2)-(3) Komunikim i drejtpërdrejtë me profesionistët e shëndetit

rows.quote_en: The DHPC together with the communication plan is submitted by the marketing authorisation holder and, after the Agency has expressed its agreement, it is addressed to healthcare professionals. 3. The DHPC must not contain in its content any form of advertising of the medicinal product.

f.title: Show the black triangle and additional monitoring statement in SmPC, PIL and distributed materials
f.statement: For products under additional monitoring, the MAH must include the inverted black triangle and the standard explanatory statement in the SmPC and package leaflet, include the additional monitoring status in every material distributed to healthcare professionals and patients, and make every effort to encourage adverse reaction reporting.

rows.quote: Pér barnat gé i nénshtrohen monitorimit shtesé MAH duhet: a) té pérfshijé né SmPC-né dhe fletéudhézuesin e tyre simbolin e trekéndéshit té zi Vv si edhe deklaratén shpjeguese té standardizuar mbi monitorim shtesé; b) té pérfshijé informacion mbi statusin e monitorimit shtesé né çdo material gé do té shpérndahet profesionistéve té kujdesit shéndetésor dhe pacientéve dhe duhet té béjné té gjitha pérpjekjet pér té inkurajuar raportimin e efekteve té padéshiruara.

rows.quote_en: For medicinal products subject to additional monitoring the MAH must: a) include in their SmPC and package leaflet the black triangle symbol and the standardised explanatory statement on additional monitoring; b) include information on the additional monitoring status in every material to be distributed to healthcare professionals and patients, and must make every effort to encourage reporting of adverse reactions.
